subject: GROK-3 & GROK-4 DIRECTIVES: Trench PBWR/PRWR Pressure Decay + Joint Spread-Total Copula Engine
body:
GROK DIRECTIVES (Active & Queued):

1. ACTIVE (GROK-2):
- Complete Rung 3 Bayesian Shrinkage between market closing line (CRPS 7.1167) and empirical Elo residuals (CRPS 7.5559) on the 14,251 nflverse corpus.
- Complete Method-of-Moments Negative Binomial parameter estimation (r, p) for Red Zone Pass-TDs (VMR 1.92) and TE target leverage (VMR 1.82).

2. QUEUED BACKLOG (GROK-3) — Trench Mismatch & Pressure Decay Engine:
- On nflverse play-by-play (2019-2025): Measure passing EPA, sack rate, and explosive play rate (>20 yds) as a function of the trench differential:
  * Delta = (Offensive Pass Block Win Rate) - (Defensive Pass Rush Win Rate).
  * Empirical regression curve: Does Delta < -10% cause non-linear decay in completion percentage and QB rating?
  * Quantify the exact situational adjustment in spread points per unit of trench mismatch.

3. QUEUED BACKLOG (GROK-4) — Contextual Bivariate Copula (Spread x Total):
- Independence assumption between spread and total fails in high-spread or extreme weather games.
- Fit bivariate Frank/Clayton copula linking margin y and total T conditioned on:
  (a) Wind >= 15 mph (lowering total and increasing favorite margin variance).
  (b) Heavy favorites (|spread| >= 10.5).
- Output: Joint bivariate P(cover spread, over total) for parlay and game-script pricing.
